searchText: <@!194432762315407360> btw, why do we need to increase packet size on 16 bytes for iv as a main purpose is blinding? We could use constant iv or 4 bytes iv (in packet) + 00x12 (in function input) If the IV for AES-CTR is re-used for multiple plaintexts on the same key, it becomes trivial to extract the key. I guess we could do it, since the key is not important at all (it's just the node id) but didn't feel like the proper way of doing things ah, yeah, ok, const could be inspected and be in the firmware of router but 4 bytes + const looks good looks a bit strange, agree, but we could save world with those 12 bytes x billions of packets 😆 yeah, I understand what you mean sometimes best not to worry about this. we could save the world in the same way by not creating this protocol at all. 🤣
